jobs.title: 2026 Summer Intern - Strategy & Operations (R5065)
jobs.content_text: Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed deep-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include the V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, Hivemind Enterprise, and the Hivemind Vision product lines. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

jobs.title: Platform Intelligence Intern
jobs.content_text:
About Zoox
Zoox is transforming mobility with fully autonomous, electric vehicles designed from the ground up for a driverless future. Our mission is to make transportation safer, more sustainable, and accessible to everyone. At Zoox, innovation, collaboration, and a bold vision for the future drive everything we do.
About Our Internship Program
Zoox’s internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry’s brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox’s mission.
About the RoleZoox is looking for a Platform Intelligence Intern to design and ship production-ready AI products for our internal platform. Today, internal users navigate multiple systems and disconnected data sources to answer everyday questions about operations, performance, and reliability. Your mission is to collapse that friction into a single, intelligent experience — one that surfaces the right metrics, predicts issues before they escalate, and answers questions in natural language. This is a hands-on, build-focused internship with definitive deliverables and measurable impact on how Zoox teams work every day.

You will own end-to-end delivery of three connected products on the internal Zoox platform:
Analytics Layer — a unified analytics surface that consolidates fragmented metrics across internal systems into a single, trustworthy view, eliminating data inconsistencies and reducing the need to query multiple tools.
Predictability Engine — ML-driven forecasting and anomaly detection on key operational metrics, giving teams early warning on trends, regressions, and capacity needs before they become incidents.
Internal Chatbot — a conversational AI assistant that lets users ask questions in plain English and instantly get the metrics, dashboards, and answers they need — a true one-stop shop for internal queries and analytics.
